mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_task_run (id, conversation_id, user_id, workflow_id, status, current_step, plan_json, plan_hash, confirmation_id, reply_saved) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{workflowId}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{planJson}, #{planHash}, #{confirmationId}, #{replySaved})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task_run SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'WAITING_CONFIRM', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < now() OR lease_owner = #{owner})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, workflow_id, status, current_step, plan_json, plan_hash, confirmation_id, result, reply_saved, lease_owner, lease_until, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_task_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < now()) ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, workflow_id, status, current_step, plan_json, plan_hash, confirmation_id, result, reply_saved, lease_owner, lease_until, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_task_run WHERE reply_saved = FALSE AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'FAILED') ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_task_run SET status = 'CANCELLED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'CANCELLED', error_message = '会话收到新消息，任务被取消', updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'WAITING_CONFIRM', 'FAILED')

UPDATE ai_task_run SET status = 'CANCELLED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'CANCELLED', error_message = '用户取消确认', updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND status IN ('PLANNING', 'WAITING_CONFIRM', 'FAILED')
